prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Ruta age35 calm tired medic, dark brown skin #6b4330, tiny dark oval dot eyes with square catchlights, straight small mouth. Long narrow off-white tunnel hood #cfc8b8, deep circular cream-grey fur ring #d9cdb8 framing recessed face with a little dark curly hair. Pale felt short coat #bdb5a3 darker side panels #9a917f, slightly crooked red cross #b23a2e near shoulder, strap to medical roll on back. Cream scarf #e3dccb two red stripes. Charcoal trousers #3a3a40 tall lace-up boots. Tall narrow silhouette but short coat hem y254 so legs visible.
Torso correction sheet, the same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Exactly THREE isolated SLEEVELESS torso parts in one horizontal row: LEFT strict FRONT view, CENTRE strict SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT (chest faces right, back left, only one flank visible), RIGHT strict BACK view (no buttons/front pockets). Each coat body from collar to hip-length hem. No head, arms, sleeve tubes, sleeve stubs, mittens or legs. Smooth continuous simple side silhouette shoulder to hem, no elbow bulges. Full solid collar top and body under shoulder joints. Pale felt body with darker side panels, crooked red cross near shoulder, diagonal strap to medical roll visible on back and profile. Cream scarf two red stripes. Transparent background. Generous blank gaps between torso parts, equal cells. Plain flat fills. No labels.
